cands.name: Brian Hodgers
cands.bio: Republican incumbent, 53. Owner of Complete Choice Insurance and Complete Choice Realty; pilot. Won the April 2025 primary and June 2025 special election for HD 32, succeeding Debbie Mayfield.

record.text: Sponsored HB 895 (trust process after a death) and HB 1343 (financial literacy and insurance education pathway); voted for SB 484 (data centers).
Won the 2025 special election over Juan Hinojosa.

controversies.text: Florida Politics reported (2025) that court records show a May 1996 citation for selling beer to a minor at a gas station he co-owned, resolved with a no-contest plea and withheld adjudication; Hodgers said a clerk was cited, that the business paid a fine, and that he was never arrested.

endorsements.text: Florida Chamber of Commerce endorsed him in the 2025 special election.

cands.gaps: Current donors not found. Owner-source check was limited: the alexjoneslive.com site search was run for this name and returned no results. stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com searches were blocked (HTTP 403) and the shared web-search quota was exhausted, so those were NOT checked.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.

cands.name: Juan Hinojosa
cands.bio: Democrat, 73. Retired Army Lieutenant Colonel (three combat tours, retired 2012); now a Northrop Grumman security officer in Melbourne. Lost the 2024 general to Debbie Mayfield and the June 2025 special election to Brian Hodgers.
cands.local_ties: Born in Falfurrias, Texas in 1952; works in Melbourne; campaign mailing address in Viera (campaign site).

record.text: Democratic nominee for HD 32 in 2024 (about 36%) and in the 2025 special election against Brian Hodgers.
